purpose: Extract Monthly Policy and Premium Activity Report for TFG Personal Lines Reporting by reading policy and premium extract files, computing unearned premium, and generating a formatted pipe-delimited report with a hardcoded KPI summary.
high_level_narrative: The program opens three sequential files: POLICY.DAT (input), PREMIUM.DAT (input), and MONTHLY_REPORT.TXT (output). It writes a header record to the report, then enters a loop reading each policy record from POLICY-IN. For each policy, it reads a corresponding premium record from PREMIUM-IN (assuming 1:1 file alignment), computes unearned premium as written premium minus earned premium, maps all fields into a formatted report record with pipe delimiters, and writes the detail line. After all policies are processed, it writes a static KPI summary section with hardcoded policy counts and a validation message, then closes all files and terminates.
inputs: POLICY.DAT (POLICY-IN) - Policy extract file containing policy number, customer ID, agent ID, product code, status
PREMIUM.DAT (PREMIUM-IN) - Premium extract file containing policy number, written premium, earned premium
outputs: MONTHLY_REPORT.TXT (REPORT-OUT) - Formatted monthly report with header, detail lines (pipe-delimited), and KPI summary section
key_transformations: Sequential read of POLICY-IN and PREMIUM-IN files in lockstep
Compute unearned premium: WS-UNEARNED = WRITTEN-PREMIUM - EARNED-PREMIUM
Map input fields to formatted report record with pipe delimiters
Write header record with column names
Write detail records for each policy-premium pair
Write static KPI summary with hardcoded totals and validation message
key_dependencies: No copybooks or external programs referenced
business_rules: UnEarned Premium = Written Premium - Earned Premium
Report month is hardcoded to '202607' (YYYYMM format)
KPI summary values are hardcoded (not derived from actual data): Total Policies=14500, Active=13100, Pending=300, Expired=800, Cancelled=300
Validation rule: 'WRITTEN = EARNED + UNEARNED : PASSED' (always printed as passed)
Assumes 1:1 correspondence between policy and premium records in file order
No conditional logic or error handling for mismatched records or missing premium data
